# Native wallet palette reference

`wallet-native-palettes.json` was generated from `OathAtmosphere/OathColorway.swift`
by running `OathSilkColors.custom` and its `OathPerceptualColor` implementation in
Foundation on the host, without launching the app or a simulator.

Rows follow the preview order: ruby, cobalt, azure, indigo, amethyst, orchid,
rose, copper, champagne, platinum. Each row contains the RGB channels of
`lightDeep`, `lightCrest`, `lightReflection`, `darkReflection`, in that order.
The website tests compare these native Float outputs with the JavaScript port.
